product.name: Acme OneTap Intent-Based Network
product.description: An intent-based transaction network that simplifies on-chain actions across 14+ blockchain networks into a single user interaction.

product.name: Acme Developer Platform
product.description: An API and SDK platform for integrating wallets, on-ramps, EIP-4337 functionality, transaction routing, and intent execution into decentralized applications.

product.name: Acme Wallet
product.description: A web-based, non-custodial smart wallet for managing digital assets, interacting with DApps, transferring assets, and bridging assets across supported networks.

product.name: Acme Checkout
product.description: A blockchain checkout and funding interface that enables users to access wallets, buy digital assets, and fund on-chain transactions using supported payment methods.

product.name: Acme Token Trading and Community Exchange Platform
product.description: A token distribution and trading-link service that lets token communities create shareable purchase links, facilitate trades across supported chains, and receive transaction-based payouts.
